purpose: Repeat frozen iOS maps/queries to check output stability and observed latency

frozenInputs.method: One child process at a time; unchanged harness/native/default config, complete sequence, new handle, no warmup or cache flush, no new build/test workload.
limitations: Unrelated desktop/system load is not isolated or stopped.
Process CPU inventory is unavailable under sandbox; load averages are recorded if available.
Three rounds have AB/BA start imbalance 2:1; OS file/CPU caches are not reset.
Queries have no independent pose truth.
94 queries share training source; 64 capture/map correspondence and independent truth are unknown.
No new geometry/feature build, algorithm change, threshold tuning, image resize or pose prior.
One replay child at a time; unrelated desktop/system load is not isolated or stopped.
Load averages before/after are not per-call CPU, memory pressure or thermal measurements.
Input SHA validation warms OS file caches; this is not a cold-start measurement.
Each run has a new process/handle and complete sequence, but within-run nearby retrieval history is retained.
AB/BA/AB order has 2:1 start imbalance; three repetitions do not support confidence bounds or deployment promises.
Per-run percentiles include all success/failure calls and exclude map load/decoding/serialization.
Across-run summaries use median/range of three run statistics; 948 correlated frames are not independent repeats.
ATC ABI does not expose exact failed retrieval/matching/PnP stages; latency differences do not identify a cause.

independentAudit.scope: Independent raw/native audit and run-level statistics/report crosscheck of the completed12-run retest; no repository/native/build/test mutation.

nativeAudit.scope: Independent per-run raw-only audit of all 12 repeated native runs; no native call/replay/build/pytest, no repository or original evidence mutation; SQLite opened mode=ro immutable. Root report_retest.py and native-summary.json were neither imported nor read.
nativeAudit.percentileMethod: Ascending sort then linear interpolation at (n-1)*percent/100 for P50/P95; every success and failed row enters each run timing denominator. No pooled or extra aggregate method selected.

harnessBoundary.staticReview: Same SHA-identified harness as prior full-identity review. It compares atc_localize return with result.status and native frame ID/timestamp plus map generation, capture clock epoch, camera ID and map instance ID before writing the row. It writes input sequence/timestamp and the other four native output identity values.
harnessBoundary.returnStatusEquality: Inspected pre-write require(ret == result.status); frames store ret once.
harnessBoundary.limits: Native duplicate frame ID/timestamp/return status fields are not separately present in JSONL, so independent offline comparison relies on the unchanged inspected harness assertion for those fields; map-load elapsed duration is recorded and cannot be reconstructed from per-frame timings.

frozenByteChecks.sourceReportNote: Historical source report identity is recorded in frozen metadata, without a report path in the frozen file list; this raw audit does not claim it is the SHA of the report currently being written.

runLevelStatisticsAudit.scope: Independent run-level statistics and serial method/report verification; no build or native API calls.
runLevelStatisticsAudit.percentileMethod: Ascending sort; linear interpolation at (n-1)*p/100, including all statuses.
runLevelStatisticsAudit.repeatUnit: One complete fresh-process/fresh-handle run; group summaries use 3 run-level values, not948 independent frames.
limitations: No causal explanation of prior long tail from timing only.
No independent pose truth or measured accuracy.
Map-load durations are quoted from summary, not reconstructed from per-frame logs.
No confidence bounds from3 correlated repetitions.

limits: 777 accepted poses checked finite/proper rigid;171 failed poses null. All948 frames kept in timing and status denominator.
Three complete runs per group are the repetition unit; no confidence bounds from948 correlated frame rows.
Map-load duration comes from its recorded summary, not per-frame reconstruction.
No causal claim about prior long tail or measured independent accuracy.
